title: Test and bind in one step

blocks.text: Pattern matching for `instanceof` tests a type and binds a variable of that type in one step, so no cast follows:
`Areas` holds three records: `Square(side)`, `Circle(radius)` and `Rectangle(width, height)`. Write `area(Object obj)` in `Areas` with one `instanceof` pattern per shape:

items: `area(new Areas.Square(3))` is `9.0`, `area(new Areas.Circle(1))` is `Math.PI`, and `area(new Areas.Rectangle(2, 5))` is `10.0`;
anything else, `null` included, is not a shape: throw `IllegalArgumentException`.

cases.says: A square of 3, a circle of 1 and a 2 by 5 rectangle have their areas.
A String and null are refused with IllegalArgumentException, not measured as 0.

concepts: obj instanceof Square square tests the type and binds a variable of that type, with no cast.
